marker_reviews.reason: The DO block's execute format only drops UNIQUE (company_code, prod_order_no, prod_line_seq) if that exact constraint still exists under a non-standard name. The static DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS in the same migration already targets the auto-named constraint, so after apply the durable catalog state is simply the absence of any unique constraint on prod_detail involving prod_line_seq. That absence is asserted by the exact_row_count check in this sidecar, by live proof .github/live-proofs/3234.sql, and by supabase/tests/coldlion_prepack_prod_detail_landing_contracts.sql. The execute creates, alters and drops no other object and writes no row.
